choices.label: Always average both heap roots even for odd total size.
choices.feedback: With odd size the extra element's heap root is the median.

choices.label: Split arriving numbers by their arrival index only.
choices.feedback: The two heaps must represent lower and upper values, not alternating arrivals.

choices.label: Maintain a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half. Repair their ordering and balance their sizes before reading the middle value or values.
choices.feedback: That matches the selected approach. Maintain a max-heap for the lower half and a min-heap for the upper half. Repair their ordering and balance their sizes before reading the middle value or values.
